title.name: Title
title.value: A parent’s guide to Science and Technology, Grades 1–8 (2022)

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

content.name: Content
content.value: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

content.name: Content
content.value: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

content.name: Content
content.value: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

content.name: Content
content.value: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on using different methods to store and process data for a variety of purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

content.name: Content
content.value: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

content.name: Content
content.value: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

content.name: Content
content.value: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

content.name: Content
content.value: analyse impacts of various social and environmental factors, human activities, and technologies on human health

content.name: Content
content.value: assess effects of a variety of social and environmental factors on human health, and describe ways in which individuals can reduce the harmful effects of these factors and take advantage of those that are beneficial

content.name: Content
content.value: evaluate beneficial and harmful effects of various technologies on human health and body systems, while taking different perspectives into consideration

content.name: Content
content.value: explain how food literacy can support decisions that affect physical and mental health

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of the structure and function of human body systems and interactions within and between systems

content.name: Content
content.value: identify systems of the human body, and describe their basic function

content.name: Content
content.value: describe the basic structure and function of vital organs in various systems in the human body

content.name: Content
content.value: describe interrelationships between human body systems

content.name: Content
content.value: identify various diseases and medical disorders in humans and the organs and/or body system or systems that they affect
